title: Obi-Wan Kenobi
subtitle: Jedi
description: After the execution of Order 66, Obi-Wan Kenobi took Luke Skywalker to his family on Tatooine and stayed closed by to watch the boy. His connection with the Force fading, Kenobi spends much of his time alone or working menial jobs. After Leia Organa is kidnapped by mercenaries, Bail Organa called on Obi-Wan to rescue his daughter.
